extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Humana plan available in Orange County has a $25 monthly premium, a $300 drug deductible and a $5600 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, the agent should avoid asking for sensitive information like Medicare number and date of birth during the call.
composition.coaching_note: During the call, Owen asked for the customer's Medicare number and date of birth, which is not recommended. This information should be collected separately and securely. Next time, ensure to only ask for necessary information after the customer has signed the Scope of Appointment.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment
